title: Sense the Shift: Business and Stewardship, with Darshita Gillies
description: A live, dialogue-led conversation about what a business holds in trust, and how honestly it can account for its effects on people and the planet. Darshita Gillies founded Maanch, a B Corp building stewardship tools for investors. A gentle first step on the Canal toward relational business. Thursday 3 December 2026, 6:30pm GMT (10:30am Pacific), 75 to 90 minutes; Online, on Zoom; Join free, or give what you can. Offered by ESSENSE Business School. Listed in the Relational River's Springs; join through the makers' own page.
